title: Bhoopathi Ranga
desc: Bhaskar, who runs away from home as a child, begins a new life in the city as Bhoopathi Ranga. Years later, he returns home but finds his mother dead and sister banished from the village.

title: Shruthi
desc: Four friends aspiring to be musicians cross paths with a woman who is searching for her lover. They see an opportunity to help each other and soon form a partnership.

title: Vardhana
desc: A man masquerades as a gangster to impress a girl he wants to marry. However, complications arise when he is entangled in a murder case.

title: Sangya Balya
desc: Veerabhadra, a landlord, comes to know that his wife, Ganga, has an affair with Sangya. He connives with Sangya's close friend, Balya, to murder him.

title: Dream Girl
desc: A carefree man decides to get his act together and moves to the city to make a name for himself in order to impress the woman he loves.
